business_description: Denormalized fact table joining user × course × certificate × exam data. One row per user-course-certificate-exam combination. Already deduplicated in the Silver view. Equivalent to gold final_view_distinct with exam data attached.
grain: One row per user × course × certificate (with exam if applicable)
primary_use_cases: Certificate counts, completion analysis, exam pass rates, course type breakdowns, time-based aggregations

business_description: Company master data with status, geography, and subscription info. One row per company. Use company_status_simple for active/trial/inactive filtering.
primary_use_cases: Company segmentation, status filtering, trial-to-subscription analysis, geographic distribution

business_description: Maps users to course assignments with completion state. Lean table: user_id, course_id, assignment_id, state, type. Use for counting assignments by state and type.
grain: One row per user × assignment × course
primary_use_cases: Assignment completion tracking, course type counts, user workload analysis

business_description: Course catalog with metadata: name, duration, description, status, and accreditation flags (CME, CNE, RBP).
primary_use_cases: Course lookup, duration analysis, accreditation filtering, content status tracking

business_description: Contract records per company: start/expiry dates, license counts, cancellation status. Use for subscription analysis.
primary_use_cases: Contract duration, license utilization, cancellation tracking, subscription lifecycle

business_description: Lookup table for company sub-types (e.g., hospital, nursing home, ambulatory). Join to mt_safe_company.subTypeId.
Individual certificate completion events: one row per certificate earned by a user for a course. Contains certificate type (Pflicht=mandatory, Wahl=elective).
primary_use_cases: Certificate volume counts, completion date analysis, mandatory vs elective breakdown

business_description: Individual exam attempt results. Contains score (resultPercentage), pass/fail (hasPassed), answer counts, and exam date.
grain: One row per exam attempt (examId × exam_userId)
primary_use_cases: Pass rate analysis, score distributions, exam difficulty assessment

business_description: Assignment definitions per company: topic, deadline, recurrence settings. Each assignment belongs to one company.
primary_use_cases: Deadline compliance, assignment structure, recurrence analysis

business_description: Salesforce opportunity records: deal pipeline with amounts, stages, win/loss, and fiscal period info. Use for revenue and sales analysis.
primary_use_cases: Pipeline analysis, win rate, revenue forecasting, sales cycle tracking
